purpose.en: Protect data while correcting one target schema.
purpose.zh: 保护数据，同时修正唯一目标结构。

owner.en: Storage owner and assigned delivery owner
owner.zh: 存储负责人及指定交付人

entry.en: A scoped format change or authorized data operation
entry.zh: 结构变化或获授权的数据操作

exit.en: Data is recoverable; the same source-to-target conversion succeeds.
exit.zh: 数据可恢复，同一个源到目标转换成功。

failure.en: Fix the same conversion; retry from unchanged backup or valid resume point.
failure.zh: 修复同一转换，从保留备份或有效续点重试。

boundary.en: Development ZIP and TAR.GZ remain unencrypted; keep recovery backup and remove disposable staging.
boundary.zh: 开发备份支持明文 ZIP 与 TAR.GZ；保留恢复备份，清理临时目录。
